answer_1.quote: We propose Multi-Hop Question Generator (MQA-QG), a simple yet general framework that decomposes the generation of a multi-hop question into two steps: 1) selecting relevant information from each data source, 2) integrating the multiple information to form a question.

answer_2.quote: We use a pretrained GPT-2 model to filter out those questions that are disfluent or unnatural. The top N samples with the lowest perplexity scores are selected as the generated dataset to train the multi-hop QA model.
